_comment: Settings for the dev tools (tools/ and ui/dev/). Not a scenario: files starting with _ are skipped when scenarios are listed.
_compare_comment: Variant comparison (tools/compare_variants.gd) defaults: the enemy level, the squad's policy (patient: waits for its strongest attack, so the wait variants show), the enemies' policy (intent, as on the battle screen), and how many fights in a row one run plays when the decision acts between fights (hp-carryover).
